summary.name: ClassPoint
summary.one_liner: ClassPoint is a PowerPoint add-in for classroom student engagement, offering interactive quizzes, polls, word clouds, gamification and presentation annotation tools inside PowerPoint.
use_cases: Running live quizzes and polls during a lesson
Generating quiz questions from existing PowerPoint slides
Gamifying classroom participation with stars and leaderboards
Annotating and drawing on slides during a presentation
Collecting student video, audio or image responses in class
Picking students randomly with a wheel of names
summary.what_it_does: ClassPoint adds interactive features to Microsoft PowerPoint so presenters can run quizzes and activities without leaving the presentation. Quiz types listed include multiple choice, polls, word cloud, fill in the blanks, short answer, video, image, slide drawing and audio record. ClassPoint AI reads slides and generates quiz questions, which can be customized by Bloom's taxonomy level and produced in many languages via OpenAI's model. Presentation tools include annotation, text boxes, inking, a whiteboard, movable elements during slideshow, and a wheel of names. Gamification adds stars, levels and leaderboards.
notable: Runs inside PowerPoint, including during slideshow mode
ClassPoint AI generates quiz questions from slides with Bloom's taxonomy options
States compliance with SOC 2, GDPR, FERPA and COPPA
Claims to serve two-thirds of schools in Singapore
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page; the listing tags it as free but the page itself does not confirm this
